run_musicgen_stereo_finetune_explorer: run the explorer function to launch SLURM jobs for fine-tuning MusicGen stereo models at 32kHz
run_small_model_finetune: run the small MusicGen stereo fine-tuning job using 32 GPUs and a pre-trained checkpoint
run_medium_model_finetune: run the medium MusicGen stereo fine-tuning job using 64 GPUs with AdamW optimizer
run_large_model_finetune: run the large MusicGen stereo fine-tuning job using 96 GPUs with classifier-free guidance and word dropout
review_explorer_config: review the explorer function configuration for stereo codebook delays, FSDP settings, and optimizer parameters
